Name: Collections
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Collects from big craftables that are 2 tiles to the left and right of it. See screenshot for example. 

Unlocked after repairing Willy's boat.

Crafting Recipe:
     - 5 iridium bars
     - 10 copper bars
     - 2 batteries

It has internal storage, if broken while containing items it will automatically drop any item within.
